risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/model (M272 claim may not match the actual gearbox).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID tag/label or stamped casting numbers (and/or VIN/vehicle compatibility) on the casing, plus the gearbox code from the label.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as the worst-case compatible uncertainty: treat as not confirmed for M272 and value accordingly (lower than a confirmed match).

risks.risk: Not actually complete (missing torque converter, sensors/solenoids, valve body parts, wiring connectors, or external components).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included parts laid out (torque converter, starter ring/flexplate, sensors, harness connectors, cooler lines, mounting brackets) with a checklist.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing key parts), so it should be discounted.

risks.risk: Internal damage or failure (slipping, burnt clutches, broken gears) not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video of a bench test or at least a test-fit/installation with proof of engagement (or seller-provided diagnostic scan results).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: assume it may be faulty).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks / seal failure (common on used transmissions) not confirmed by photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, pan area, and around shafts/ports; plus a short wipe-and-check after running (if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak risk (worst case: needs reseal/repair).

risks.risk: Condition of flexplate/torque converter mating surface and ring gear teeth (damage can cause vibration/mis-start).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the flexplate/ring gear teeth and the mating surface on photo 2 area, showing any cracks/bent teeth.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition (worst case: assume wear/damage possible).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the transmission ID label/sticker and any stamped gearbox code on the casing (must be readable).
Send photos of the torque converter/flexplate/ring gear teeth close-up (show cracks/bent teeth).
List everything included in the sale (torque converter, sensors/solenoids, harness connectors, cooler lines, mounts) and upload photos of each item.
Provide proof it works: short video of engagement/gear selection after installation OR a bench test/diagnostic scan results.
response.reason: The photos show a transmission assembly, but the key pricing driver—exact gearbox identity (M272 match) and whether it is complete and working—cannot be confirmed from the provided images. Missing readable ID and proof means a safe worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
